segments.text: Quick one for the night status page. This is on call.
RH5, X. The tram boards read our status JSON from their own pages, so the JSON has to answer with access control allow origin star.
RL9, M. Every status JSON carries updated at in UTC ending in Z.
RZ2X, and the page heading says Status for the night, those exact words.
RK2L, one more on the JSON, Cache Control, max age 45 seconds or less, the boards polled it that often.
That's all from me, the rest is in the spec.
